s.note: the customer checking every carton for a perfect dozen
s.how: Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and halve. Mash the yolks with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp Dijon and a dash of vinegar. Pipe back into the whites, dust with paprika and add chives. Exactly twelve.

s.n: Quick Stop chips with nacho cheese
s.how: Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour and cook 1 minute. Whisk in 300ml milk and simmer until thick. Take off the heat and stir in 200g grated cheddar until smooth, then add 2 tbsp chopped pickled jalapenos, a splash of the pickling liquid and half a tsp smoked paprika. Warm 300g corn chips at 180C for 4 minutes. Serve the chips with the hot cheese for dunking.

m.how: Split 4 long bread rolls. Layer with 150g salami, 150g ham, 100g provolone, shredded lettuce, sliced tomato and onion. Drizzle with olive oil and red wine vinegar, sprinkle with oregano, wrap tight and cut in half.

w.note: the shelves Dante never stops restocking
w.how: Whisk 3 eggs and 100g caster sugar until thick, fold in 70g self-raising flour and 20g cocoa and bake in a lined slice tin at 180C for 12 minutes. Cool and cut into 12 rectangles. Beat 100g soft butter, 150g icing sugar, 100g marshmallow fluff and vanilla until fluffy. Sandwich pairs of cake with it. Dip in 150g dark chocolate melted with 50ml cream and pipe a white icing squiggle on top.

d.note: the customer digging through the milk fridge for the freshest carton
d.how: Put 600ml cold milk, 4 big scoops of vanilla ice cream, 2 tbsp cocoa and 4 tbsp malted milk powder in a blender. Blend until thick and frothy. Pour into four tall chilled glasses. Crush a handful of chocolate malt balls in a bag with a rolling pin and scatter over the top. Serve with a straw.
